cohort: Hospitalized pregnant women with a diagnosis of AML from the National Inpatient Sample database between 2000 and 2014.
finding: Mortality in pregnant women hospitalized with AML has been declining over the past 15 years, vaginal delivery was more common than cesarean section, and a higher Charlson's comorbidity score was an independent predictor of mortality.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was more common than cesarean section in pregnant women with AML (4% vs. 2.8%).
